name: NinjaOne City · Round 1
domainSummary: A unified endpoint-management capital built around centralized control, a lightweight distributed agent, policy automation, remote support, real-time action, and resilience.

researchSources.title: The NinjaOne Platform
researchSources.use: Unified cloud-native platform, centralized console, manage/protect/support hierarchy, automation, and resilience.

researchSources.title: NinjaOne Endpoint Management
researchSources.use: Real-time visibility and control, policy-based automation, patching, and distributed endpoint operations.

researchSources.title: NinjaOne FAQ
researchSources.use: One lightweight endpoint agent communicating with the centralized platform.

assets.name: Unified Endpoint Citadel
assets.controlledVariable: central command with four radial endpoint pavilions
assets.thesis: One dominant command hall and standardized radial pavilions make unified endpoint control the primary identity.
assets.businessCue: One centralized platform managing many distributed endpoints.

assets.name: Policy Beacon Forum
assets.controlledVariable: policy propagation and vertical beacon hierarchy
assets.thesis: Concentric terraces and standardized annexes express consistent policy flowing from a clear central authority.

assets.name: Relay Crown Capitol
assets.controlledVariable: secure relay bridges and nested rings
assets.thesis: Inhabited bridges crossing nested rings turn secure remote rendezvous into the capital's defining structure.
assets.businessCue: Fast remote access coordinated through the unified platform.

assets.name: Resilience Vault Assembly
assets.controlledVariable: protected archive center and redundant connected shell
assets.thesis: A protected central archive and redundant connected circulation make continuity and restoration the dominant idea.
assets.businessCue: Backup, protection, and recovery without operational fragmentation.

assets.name: Technician Arcade
assets.controlledVariable: accessible service forum and practical intervention
assets.thesis: A grand open service forum prioritizes technician access and rapid practical intervention over defensive massing.
assets.businessCue: Hands-on support and fast resolution for end users.

assets.name: Multi-Tenant Ring
assets.controlledVariable: segmented tenant halls under shared governance
assets.thesis: Independently legible tenant halls lock into one continuous ring around a shared council chamber.
assets.businessCue: Distributed client environments managed through common governance.

assets.name: Protection and Patch Foundry
assets.controlledVariable: layered maintenance courts and protective roof plates
assets.thesis: Layered roof plates and orderly maintenance courts express continuous upkeep without literal patch iconography.
assets.businessCue: Autonomous patching, remediation, and ongoing endpoint protection.

assets.name: Cross-Platform Confluence
assets.controlledVariable: three distinct architectural wings converging on one center
assets.thesis: Three different structural languages converge on one operations center, making diversity inside a unified platform visible.
assets.businessCue: Common management across multiple endpoint and operating-system families.

assets.name: Remote Bridge Capitol
assets.controlledVariable: inhabited control bridge between endpoint halls
assets.thesis: A grand inhabited bridge makes secure remote connection the architectural heart of the capital.
assets.businessCue: Technicians securely connecting to remote endpoints through the platform.

assets.name: Unified Operations Crown
assets.controlledVariable: balanced synthesis of command, automation, service, and protection
assets.thesis: A restrained octagonal crown balances unified command, technician access, layered protection, and standardized endpoint halls.
assets.businessCue: Manage, protect, and support through one unified operations platform.
